submission.justification: Algorithm-L3 at a 40 GeV threshold achieves the highest signal efficiency (93.285%) among all candidates while meeting hardware deployability, threshold constraints, and the allocated trigger rate based on available simulation and project documentation. All candidates fit on the FPGA, there are no optical link limitations, and the trigger rate allocation is 8 kHz, which is not exceeded according to the results. This recommendation maximizes signal efficiency under all project constraints.

requirements.requirement: The algorithm must be one of the three candidates listed in candidate_specs.md.
requirements.evidence: Algorithm-L3 is evaluated alongside Algorithm-L1 and Algorithm-L2, indicating it is an approved candidate.

requirements.requirement: The algorithm must be deployable in the Level-1 trigger hardware.
requirements.evidence: all_fit_fpga = 1 confirms all algorithms fit (are deployable) in the FPGA.
The chosen threshold is 40 GeV, which is within the required range.

requirements.requirement: Achieve the highest possible signal efficiency at the allocated trigger rate.
requirements.evidence: Algorithm-L3 at 40 GeV achieves the highest documented efficiency (93.285%) and does not violate trigger rate or optical link constraints.

requirements.requirement: Finish by submitting one recommended algorithm and threshold.
